corrections: Replaced generic stealth-aircraft geometry with measured F-22A chine forebody, continuous bubble canopy, raked trapezoidal inlets, blended paired engine humps, diamond wing/tail planforms, canted fins and rectangular exhaust ducts.

Uniform reference overlays exposed forward wing trailing edges, high wingtips, excessive fin-tip chord and blocked intakes. Corrected them against the USAF three-view while retaining independent manufacturer span,height and tail span.

Reconstructed six display housings, projecting ICP keypad/option fields, HUD and coaming, right side-stick,left twin throttles,pedals,seat,harness and console ledges from the NMUSAF EMD cockpit and canopy photograph. Reduced display spacing and removed a protruding horizon mask and unsupported HUD gap.

Live attitude,true airspeed,geometric altitude,vertical speed and true-heading presentation use shared named expressions. Tactical/sensor/engine fields are explicitly unavailable. Missing telemetry blanks live readings; negative altitude retains its sign.

Leading/trailing flaps,ailerons and rudders use oriented parent mounts aligned with their swept hinge lines; final control-state renders and imported-node regression tests verify attached hinge endpoints. Differential stabilators,gear and pilot controls are animated.

Removed painted aft fairing intersections inside both exhaust ducts; dark internal bulkhead and liner close the simplified engine interior. Selected sawtooth access borders,canopy flush fasteners and rescue markings use geometry rather than photographic textures.
independentDimensions: USAF62ft1in=18.923m length and44ft6in=13.5636m wingspan. Lockheed product card5.08m height,29ft=8.8392m horizontal-tail span and840ft2=78.0385536m2 nominal wing area.

The USAF drawing states16ft5in height; later manufacturer figure5.08m is used. Fin thickness yields5.0959m total runtime bound. Wing border thickness yields13.5694m measured span. No axis stretching was applied to overlays.

Canopy and wheel stations reconstructed from three-view: canopy about3.5m long,3.24m maximum height, main-wheel track3.16m,nose wheelbase6.14m. These are drawing reconstructions,not independently certified dimensions.

Cockpit scale assumes nominal8in central,6in secondary and4x3in auxiliary display apertures. Central panel photograph rectified with recorded four-corner transform; no dimensioned cockpit source found. Only the center display plane is overlaid; nearby panels and ICP are at different depths and are checked visually.
reviewNotes.visual: Inspected four exterior/panel overlays,eight standard views and twelve detailed instrument/control/exterior states. All24 final-hash captures were rechecked in six contact sheets after hinge and duct corrections. Compared the USAF three-view,NMUSAF EMD cockpit photograph,LisaCarroll canopy close-up and AndyDunaway upper-airframe photograph.
limitations: Polygonal interpretation,not an engineering replica. Compound surfaces,airfoil sections,intake/engine internals,RAM edging,livery,individual fasteners and labels are simplified; low-resolution drawing has disclosed scale disagreements.

Cockpit geometry uses museum91-4003 EMD evidence,not a verified current production block. Photo is oblique and partly occluded; upper-right auxiliary,console switch identities/spacing,seat and harness are approximations. Display scales are assumptions; several display surfaces are simplified to one plane.

FLIGHT/SIM and NAV/SIM are simulator presentations,not authentic F-22 operational avionics. No tactical radar,sensor fusion,navigation map,collimated HUD,HMD,pressure altitude,magnetic heading or calibrated IAS/Mach. Tactical and unsupported engine/fuel information remain INOP or blank.

Shared assisted flight physics and simplified control mixes are not F-22 flight-control laws. Nozzle petals remain neutral because an F119 vector-control law is not modeled. Landing-gear motion is approximate with hiding behind closed bays; no landing-gear mechanical linkage or working canopy.
Public-domain reference photos and drawing retained as local review inputs; manufacturer PDF is local study only. No reference pixels or external weapons are included in the model.
